lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Subordinate,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: there's something I wanted to ask you.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Is this a good time?
Sure, shoot.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I wanted to ask

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: what kind of women's clothing do you prefer.
Could you be more precise?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Are you more of a fan of casual sportswear,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: or something frilly and cute?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Maybe something clean-cut, like a pantsuit?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Or...

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Sharp, meticulously crafted military uniforms?
The most important thing is wearing whatever suits you.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: By that,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: do you mean the answer depends on the individual?
Exactly.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Hmm...
Is something the matter?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: No, nothing like that, but...

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: You know how it costs a fortune to maintain the Admire, don't you?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: All the donations we scrap together aren't enough,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: so I often end up chipping in some of my own salary to cover the costs.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Because of that, I don't really have the luxury of treating myself to any nice clothing.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I'm sure you've noticed how I tend to wear either the same old military uniform

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: or other clothes that are donated.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Anyway... how should I put this...

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I was wondering if dressing up nice

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: can make you have a more commanding presence.
I think the way you look now is perfect.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I mean, I'm a fan of military uniforms, so I really don't have any complaints.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Still, shouldn't I at least buy a few other outfits just in case?
We can go pick out some together.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: You and me?
Sure. I'll help you pick out the ones that look good on you.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I'd be so grateful if you did.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I have no fashion sense whatsoever,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: so I'd be helpless otherwise.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I'll get in touch with you on my next day off,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: and thank you for hearing me out.
